_comment: Fixed benchmark set for the OpenRouter ingestion test harness (see eval/README.md). 10 open-access articles across arXiv, ERIC, and PubMed Central, chosen for topical overlap with existing wiki content (spacing/retrieval practice, worked examples/cognitive load, self-regulation/feedback) so validator and judge scores are meaningful. Spot-check URLs before a paid run if this list has aged. PMC entries fetch via the BioC-PMC API (fetch_url), not by scraping the article HTML page (url) — see eval/SOURCES.md for why, and for the per-source compliance notes generally.
